notes:
Original full text unavailable: DOI landing route failed, Springer PDF returned non-PDF HTML, OpenAlex and Unpaywall reported no open-access location, and a targeted open-access search found no original full paper. No original statistics were taken from the replication background. Replication title and DOI verified against the supplied reference. The chocolate confectionary comparison is the closest located outcome; the source locator does not specify a category, and no leader-versus-follower or young-adult subgroup test was found. Target mismatch is explicit. The replication prints group means 3.00 (10–11am) and 3.65 (3–4pm), but no mean difference or ANOVA F statistic; es remains null and no difference was computed. Other category comparisons were not merged: soft drinks p < 0.05 and crisps p > 0.05. Reported failure is the author narrative rejecting the Roehm and Roehm compensating mechanism, rather than an inference from significance. Analytic n is not equated with the generic panel total.
Source follow-up: Rendered primary PDF p. 5 inspected and interaction numerics verified. Requested mean difference is not printed for the interaction; retain printed λ and F rather than deriving a mean difference. Follow-up brand-specific means/tests are distinct from this interaction. Published article version retained. Original-only target; replication and narrative replication-success verdict unassigned.
